supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show LDAP and Kerberos traffic from WS-EBROOKS-01 to DC-BLU-01, including LDAP connections at 13:35 and 13:36 and a Kerberos connection at 13:35.

WS-EBROOKS-01 had WmiPrvSE-related process activity around 13:24–13:26, including a WmiPrvSE process-access event and WmiPrvSE process creation events; these records do not show an account-creation command.
The supplied sequence jumps from a 13:36:18 LDAP record to a 13:46:29 Kerberos record, so it contains no event record covering the approximate 13:42 alert time.
